facts.text: Serve the snacks when Tiana hands Charlotte a plate of hot beignets.
facts.why: Tiana serves beignets to Big Daddy La Bouff at the cafe ('Got me a fresh batch just waitin' for you'). Charlotte only asks her to make beignets for the ball.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Tiana serves Big Daddy a fresh batch of beignets.
facts.applied_note: Dropped La Bouff to keep the cue near its old length.

facts.text: Eat the gumbo, look at the beignets, then tell me to slow down. Go ahead. This restaurant is happening.
facts.why: Invented. Tiana never says this. Her real beignet line is to Big Daddy La Bouff at the cafe.
facts.fix: Beignets? Got me a fresh batch just waitin' for you.

fix_note.text: Beignets? Got me a fresh batch just waitin' for you.

facts.text: Big Daddy La Bouff's Mardi Gras toast.
facts.why: Big Daddy is crowned Mardi Gras king, but no toast or Sazerac shows up in the sources opened.
facts.fix: Big Daddy La Bouff, Mardi Gras king, would order this.

vibe.verdict: Tiana's Palace and the New Orleans food are right, but the best scenes are mostly missing.
missing: Tiana lent a princess dress at Charlotte's masquerade ball
The kiss that turns Tiana into a frog (ball)
Louis the jazz alligator and his trumpet (bayou)
Dr Facilier's voodoo talisman and shadow friends (street)
Young Tiana adding hot sauce to her dad's gumbo (kitchen)
Daddy James writing 'Tiana's Place' on the paper (opening)
ideas: Swap 'Daddy James's chicken and sausage gumbo' note for 'Tiana adds the hot sauce, her daddy tastes it first'.
Swap 'Bayou crab cakes' note for 'Louis plays trumpet while the frogs eat'.
Add 'Tiana's Place' scribbled on the bill as the prop.
